nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L/K$ a field extension such that the map $A \to L$ factors as $A \to K \to L$. An intermediate field $E$ of $L/K$ is finite unramified relative to $A$ if $E$ is finite-dimensional over $K$ and the integral closure of $A$ in $E$ is formally unramified over $A$.
nodes.title: Finite unramified intermediate fields

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L/K$ a field extension such that the map $A \to L$ factors as $A \to K \to L$. Every intermediate field $E$ of $L/K$ that is finite unramified relative to $A$ is contained in the maximal unramified subextension of $L/K$ relative to $A$.
nodes.title: Finite unramified subfields lie in the maximal unramified subextension

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L/K$ a field extension such that the map $A \to L$ factors as $A \to K \to L$, and let $M$ be the maximal unramified subextension of $L/K$ relative to $A$. For every $K$-algebra automorphism $\sigma$ of $L$, $\sigma(M) = M$.
nodes.title: The maximal unramified subextension is stable under automorphisms

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L/K$ a field extension such that the map $A \to L$ factors as $A \to K \to L$. If an intermediate field $E$ of $L/K$ is finite unramified relative to $A$, then for every $K$-algebra automorphism $\sigma$ of $L$ the image $\sigma(E)$ is finite unramified relative to $A$.
nodes.title: Automorphisms preserve finite unramified subfields

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L/K$ a field extension such that the map $A \to L$ factors as $A \to K \to L$. An intermediate field $F$ of $L/K$ contains the maximal unramified subextension of $L/K$ relative to $A$ if and only if $F$ contains every intermediate field of $L/K$ that is finite unramified relative to $A$.
nodes.title: Universal property of the maximal unramified subextension

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $L/K$ a field extension such that the map $A \to L$ factors as $A \to K \to L$. The maximal unramified subextension of $L/K$ relative to $A$ is the supremum, in the lattice of intermediate fields of $L/K$, of all intermediate fields of $L/K$ that are finite unramified relative to $A$.
nodes.title: Maximal unramified subextension

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
